_comment: Add this object to the 'modules' array in Schwung's module-catalog.json (PR against charlesvestal/schwung). The module has run on a Move; release.json and the tarball are on the release.

entries.name: Clementine-XT
entries.description: Ten-voice wavetable synth in the style of the Microwave II/XT: two wavetable oscillators, 13 filter types, 16-slot mod matrix, effects and arpeggiator. Bring your own ROM files.
entries.author: sd88me
entries.requires: Optional: your own Microwave II ROM dump (two 128 KB chip images or one 256 KB image) in /data/UserData/schwung/clementine-xt/ROMS/ for the original waves and the factory sounds. Without it a built-in bank plays on open wave tables.
